summary.zh: 集合是行动小队进入可执行任务的公开行动状态。成员脱离普通日程并集中在小队位置，能力按完整水平计算。
summary.en: Assembled is an active squad state for executing tasks. Members leave normal schedules, gather at the squad position, and use full effectiveness.

items.zh: 成员会脱离普通学生日程 AI。
items.en: Members leave normal student schedule AI.

items.zh: 小队能力按完整水平参与行动计算。
items.en: Squad abilities are counted at full effectiveness.

items.zh: 地图标记使用菱形队旗表现集合状态。
items.en: The map marker uses a diamond-shaped flag to show assembled status.

items.zh: 集合状态更容易暴露组织行动。
items.en: The assembled state makes organization activity easier to notice.

items.zh: 集合状态迁移总部时，小队需要移动到目标位置，不能瞬间完成。
items.en: When relocating headquarters while assembled, the squad must move to the target position instead of teleporting.
